usedFor: CompanyCam holds job site photos and projects, and “New Project” can start “Trigger Command” in TRIGGERcmd on your computers.

bestTemplate.name: “New Project” in CompanyCam, then “Trigger Command” in TRIGGERcmd
bestTemplate.why: A new CompanyCam project runs a command on your computers.

watchOut: “Trigger Command” acts on your computers, so prefer “New Project” over “Comment All”, which covers every comment event.
